Tool names here are Academic Harness's own. In Claude Code, `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, `ask_user_question` is `AskUserQuestion`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## Study conduct, ethics, and grants

`preregister` freezes the question, design, sample-size basis, hypotheses, outcomes, exclusions, stopping rules, and analysis plan into a hashed, write-once version under `.dsh/preregister/<slug>/`. Freeze before data collection; if data already exist, say so and record the reason. A post-freeze edit needs `new_version: true` and a reason, and the earlier version stays. `verify` re-hashes every version; `export` writes Markdown/JSON (with OSF/AsPredicted-shaped fields) or a PDF. The tool never submits to a registry — `submit` is disabled.

- `causal_dag` makes assumptions explicit and derives graph properties: d-separation, minimal backdoor adjustment sets, front-door sets, collider/M-bias warnings, instrument candidates, testable implications, and E-values. The DAG is the user's; an adjustment set satisfies the graph criterion, not a guarantee of identification. No model is fitted and no effect is estimated — do that in `analysis_run` with explicit code.
- `design` makes randomization and DOE reproducible: a seed is required; simple/block/stratified/cluster/crossover/minimization schedules store allocation and blinding codes; `balance` reports realized balance (never a guarantee); DOE (full/fractional factorial, Plackett–Burman, central composite, Box–Behnken) reports its assumed model and aliasing. Randomization codes are not allocation concealment.
- `ethics_protocol` drafts a protocol and consent and checks concepts against Helsinki/Common Rule/GDPR/HIPAA themes. It is template/checklist support, not legal advice; approval references are recorded, never verified or invented, and institution-specific requirements stay `manual_check`. `deidentify` scans and redacts PHI/PII locally with regex/heuristics and a masked report; it makes no model/network call, writes no reversible mapping, and does not certify HIPAA/GDPR compliance. A human must review every report and output.
- `dmp` drafts NIH/NSF/Horizon/Wellcome/ERC/generic data-management plans; templates are paraphrased concepts, and repository, embargo, costs, and official requirements stay `manual_check`. `grant_budget` computes a multi-year table from explicit salaries, effort, fringe, escalation, indirect rate, and caps with arithmetic checks and a justification; it never invents a rate or decides allowability. Use the same slug across `preregister`, `ethics_protocol`, `dmp`, and the data/repro ledgers to link them.

Load `preregistering-analysis`, `causal-dag`, `experimental-design`, `research-ethics`, `data-management-plan`, or `grant-budget` for the detailed workflows.
